No wait, gray is rows 36-47, cols 3-17: it covers rows 42-47 of that region. Yellow's top bar was rows 42-44, cols 9-17 → covered by gray (drawn on top). Yellow's middle + bottom are rows 45-53: rows 45-47 are covered, rows 48-53 are visible. So gray is sitting on top of yellow, 6 rows too high.
Need 2 more DOWNs (rows 36→42). Then gray = rows 42-53, cols 3-17 = exactly matches yellow → level clear (probably).
So just 2 more DOWNs. Execute.
